newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Delta says Q1 gold output falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Delta says Q1 gold output falls.

text.p: Delta Gold NL said its production share from Western Australian gold mines in the 1996/97 first quarter fell to 42,143 ounces from 46,067 a year ago and 47,693 ounces in the June 1996 quarter.
The cash operating cost rose to A$357 per ounce from A$284.

Delta also said it and 60 percent partner Placer Pacific Ltd had increased estimated reserves at the Sunrise pit located at the Granny Smith gold mine to 352,600 ounces, a rise of 210,400 on the reserve published in the latest annual report.
Delta said its half share of first quarter output from the 50 percent-owned Kanowna Belle mine was 19,965 ounces compared with 22,847 a year ago and 17,444 in the June 1996 quarter.
North Ltd owns the remainder of Kanowna Belle.
Delta said its 40 percent share of production from Granny Smith fell to 22,178 ounces in the latest quarter from 23,220 a year ago and 30,249 in the June quarter.
It said at the end of the first quarter, 29 percent of its Australian gold reserves were committed to forward contracts but no new contracts were entered into in the latest three months.
